title: HM3: Heterogeneous Multi-Class Model Merging
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology for merging heterogeneous classifiers (HM3). While it uses guardrail models (such as jailbreak and hate speech detectors) as test cases, the evaluation is centered on classification performance metrics like F1-scores and inference speed rather than an exploration or benchmarking of religious, spiritual, or ethical/moral frameworks.
